newsitem.title: USA: North American bunker prices steady, LA stronger.
newsitem.headline: North American bunker prices steady, LA stronger.

text.p: North American bunker prices held steady early this week except for the West Coast, which has begun to creep up due to low inventory concerns, players said Tuesday.
Although steady on Thursday, the Los Angeles market had moved up $5 a tonne by Tuesday amid concern availability of resupply will be tight in May.
In the hub 380 CST was pegged between $102 a tonne and $103 a tonne, with 180 CST at $106/107 a tonne.
